title: F12 · agent worker / cron fail-closed in production
goal: The /api/agents/tick and /api/agents/workflows worker endpoints currently return authorized when AGENT_WORKER_SECRET/PRAXIS_EVENT_SECRET is unset (open in demo / first boot). In production this is an unauthenticated cron trigger. Fail closed in production: when NODE_ENV=production and no secret is configured, reject with 401 and audit-warn. Non-production keeps the open-for-demo behavior. Suggestion-only; no auto merge/deploy.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Shared authorizeWorker helper fails closed when NODE_ENV=production and no secret set (401)
Non-production with no secret remains open for demo / first boot
Secret set: timing-safe compare of x-agent-worker-secret / Bearer header
Both /api/agents/tick and /api/agents/workflows use the shared helper
Vitest covers prod-fail-closed, dev-open, secret-match, secret-mismatch; typecheck green
